interpretation.primary: Average concordance across mixed held-out quartets, with quartets weighted equally.
interpretation.secondary: Concordance across all failure/nonfailure pairs in mixed quartets, with pairs weighted equally.
interpretation.ties: Exact equal scores receive one-half credit.
interpretation.fixed_thresholds: Thresholds 0.05, 0.10, and 0.20 are fixed descriptive research operating points; no test-set optimization.
interpretation.agreement: Agreement is an uncalibrated ranking score; its threshold is not a probability threshold.
interpretation.scope: Recording-source-excluded computational replay from one coded series; no independent-patient inference.
